visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white cat is seen inside a litter box, sniffing and pawing at the grey granular litter. Large white text overlays the center of the frame. The setting is a brightly lit indoor space with wooden floors. (2) A black and white cat walks across a light-colored wooden floor in a hallway. The camera pans to follow its movement. (3) A close-up of a small tabby kitten in a litter box. A human hand enters the frame and demonstrates a digging motion in the litter near the kitten. (4) Various types of cat litter are shown being poured and handled, including grey granules, yellowish pellets, and long white cylindrical pieces. (5) An orange and white cat jumps into a specialized litter box through a circular entrance in a wooden cabinet. It then peaks its head out. (10) A white cat with grey spots lies on a table, followed by a tortoiseshell cat looking around with wide, expressive eyes.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Introduction -> Explanation of Instinct -> Reason 1 (Texture) -> Reason 2 (Territory) -> Reason 3 (Health/Pain) -> Conclusion -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This educational video aims to teach cat owners three primary reasons why their cats might stop burying their waste—covering issues ranging from litter texture preference to territorial behavior and potential medical pain—while providing practical advice on how to diagnose and address the issue.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is structured as educational content for cat owners rather than a promotion for a specific brand of litter, although various litter types are displayed as examples.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features professional studio-quality audio and high-definition visuals centered on feline behavior. It is a well-structured informational segment by the popular creator 'Lady Flavor'.
